interpretation.gibbs_fidelity: Squared Uhlmann fidelity between reduced rho_A and exact rho_beta; 1 is perfect.
interpretation.trace_distance: One-half trace norm of rho_A-rho_beta; 0 is perfect and larger is more distinguishable.
interpretation.matrix_difference: Elementwise absolute value of complex matrix difference |rho_A-rho_beta|.
